name: Fask
description: A clever brute and the warlord who rules Kroog; he is haunted by an oracle's curse and sees a spirit in his chamber.

description_citations.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
description_citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Fask, the Tyrant of Kroog, rigs his chamber with strings of noisy objects because an oracle's curse haunts him.
timeline.quote: This was Fask's trap, his system to prove he was not mad but perceptive.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Fask sees a half-formed spirit at the foot of his bed and screams.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Many centuries later, an old man tells his grandchildren the story of the tyrant and the ghost during the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: The Ice Age was upon Dominaria

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The warlord Fask claims Kroog's seat by force; his soldiers abandon him around 85 AR and his realm is carved up.
